claims.summary: The Japan Foundation states that group 1 verbs conjugate the dictionary-form ending -u and illustrates this with 働く and 作る.

locators.description: Elementary 1, Lesson 1, PDF p. 18 (printed L1-18), group table: group 1 dictionary-form ending -u conjugates, with 働く→働きます and 作る→作ります.
